==English==
{{wp|<dab!>}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈtɹaɪəl/|[tɹaɪəl]}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-trial.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|aɪəl|s=2}}
* {{hyphenation|en|tri|al}}

===Etymology 1===
{{etymon|en|:inh|enm:trial<ety:ubor<xno:trial>>|tree=1}}
From {{inh|en|enm|trial}}, {{m|enm|triall}}, from {{der|en|xno|trial}}, {{m|fro|triel}}, from {{m|fro|trier||to pick out, cull}} + {{m|fro|-al}}. More at English {{m|en|try}}.

====Noun====
{{wp}}
{{en-noun}}

# An [[occasion]] on which a [[person]] or [[thing]] is [[test#Verb|tested]] to find out how well they [[perform]] or how [[suitable]] they are.
#: {{syn|en|test}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=c. 1611|author={{w|William Shakespeare}}|title={{w|The Tempest}}|section=Act IV, Scene 1|url=https://www.opensourceshakespeare.org/views/plays/play_view.php?WorkID=tempest&Scope=entire&pleasewait=1&msg=pl
|passage=all thy vexations / Were but my '''trials''' of thy love and thou / Hast strangely stood the test here}}
#* {{RQ:Anne Bronte Agnes Grey|chapter=3|page=51|passage=had my powers been less limited, I might have enforced obedience; but as it was, it was but a '''trial''' of strength between her and me, in which she generally came off victorious}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2010|author={{w|Nadifa Mohamed}}|title={{w|Black Mamba Boy}}|publisher=Harper Collins|page=65|url=https://archive.org/details/blackmambaboy00moha/page/65/mode/1up?q=trial
|passage=Jama saw the sweaty, smelly work as a kind of test that, if passed, would entitle him to see his father, a '''trial''' of his worth as a son and as a man.}}
## The testing of a [[product]] or [[procedure]].
##: {{ux|en|They will perform the '''trials''' for the new equipment next week.}}
## {{lb|en|medicine|science|research}} A [[research]] [[study]] to test the [[effective]]ness and [[safety]] of a [[drug]], medical procedure, etc.
##: {{syn|en|clinical trial}}
##: {{ux|en|A randomized, controlled '''trial''' (RCT).}}
## An event in which [[athlete]]s’ or animals’ abilities are tested as they [[compete]] for a place on a team, or to move on to the next level of a [[championship]], for example.
##: {{co|en|soccer '''trials'''; sheepdog '''trials'''}}
## {{lb|en|ceramics}} A piece of [[ware]] used to test the [[heat]] of a [[kiln]].
## {{lb|en|UK}} An [[internal]] [[examination]] set by {{w|Eton College}}.
## {{lb|en|archaic}} An occasion on which [[army|armies]] or individuals meet in [[combat]].
##* {{quote-book|en|year=c. 1597|author={{w|William Shakespeare}}|title={{w|Henry IV, Part 1}}|section=Act V, Scene 1|url=https://www.opensourceshakespeare.org/views/plays/play_view.php?WorkID=henry4p1&Scope=entire&pleasewait=1&msg=pl
|passage=In both your armies there is many a soul / Shall pay full dearly for this encounter, / If once they join in '''trial'''.}}
# {{lb|en|legal}} A meeting or series of meetings in a [[court of law]] at which [[evidence]] is presented to a [[judge]] (and sometimes a [[jury]]) to allow them to [[decide]] on a [[legal]] matter (especially whether an [[accuse]]d person is [[guilty]] of a [[crime]]).
#: {{syn|en|court case}}
#: {{ux|en|If you are convicted at '''trial''', you have the right to file an appeal.}}
#: {{ux|en|He was charged with war crimes and brought to '''trial''' before the International Tribunal.}}
#: {{ux|en|The journalists have been held in custody for three years without '''trial'''.}}
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Winter's Tale|III|3|passage=as she hath / Been publicly accused, so shall she have / A just and open '''trial'''}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1847|author={{w|Henry Wadsworth Longfellow}}|title={{w|Evangeline}}|location=Boston|publisher=Ticknor|section=Part 3, p. 42|url=https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=mdp.39015089259124&seq=52&q1=trial&start=1
|passage=She, after form of '''trial''' condemned to die on the scaffold, / Patiently met her doom at the foot of the statue of Justice.}}
#* {{RQ:Harper Lee Mockingbird|chapter=20|page=215|passage={{...}} this case should never have come to '''trial'''.}}
#* '''2020''', {{w|Charles Yu}}, ''{{w|Interior Chinatown}},'' New York: Pantheon, Act{{nbsp}}VI,
# A [[difficult]] or [[annoying]] [[experience]] or person; {{lb|en|especially|religion}} such an experience seen as a [[test]] of [[faith]] and [[piety]].
#: {{ux|en|That boy was a '''trial''' to his parents.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1678|author={{w|John Bunyan}}|title={{w|The Pilgrim's Progress|The Pilgrim’s Progress}}|location=London|publisher=Nath. Ponder|page=172|url=http://name.umdl.umich.edu/A30170.0001.001
|passage=That they are Cowards, many have said, but few have found it so in the time of '''Trial'''.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1818|author={{w|Mary Shelley}}|title={{w|Frankenstein}}|location=London|publisher=Lackington, Hughes, Harding, Mavor, & Jones|volume=1|chapter=5|page=120|url=https://archive.org/details/shelleyfrankenstein01/page/120/mode/1up?q=trials
|passage=Poor Justine was very ill; but other '''trials''' were reserved for her.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1908|author={{w|Lucy Maud Montgomery}}|title={{w|Anne of Green Gables}}|location=Toronto|publisher=Ryerson Press|chapter=12|page=108|url=https://archive.org/details/anneofgreengable00montiala/page/108/mode/1up?q=trial
|passage=I’m afraid I’m going to be a dreadful '''trial''' to you. Maybe you’d better send me back to the asylum.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1955|author={{w|J. R. R. Tolkien}}|title={{w|The Return of the King}}|location=New York|publisher=Ballantine Books|year_published=1973|chapter=4|page=98|url=https://archive.org/details/returnofking0000tolk_t1r7/page/98/mode/1up?q=trial
|passage={{...}} I’m not used {{...}} to waiting hungry on others while they eat. It is a sore '''trial''' for a hobbit, that.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2008|author={{w|Tan Twan Eng}}|title={{w|The Gift of Rain}}|location=New York|publisher=Weinstein Books|section=Book 2, Chapter 13, p. 365|url=https://archive.org/details/giftofrain00tant/page/365/mode/1up?q=trials
|passage=You must be strong now, for your greatest '''trials''' are still ahead.}}
# {{lb|en|archaic}} The action of [[try]]ing (to do) something, especially more than once. (''This sense is still current in the expression'' [[trial and error]].)
#: {{syn|en|attempt#Noun|try#Noun}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1719|author={{w|Daniel Defoe}}|title={{w|Robinson Crusoe}}|location=London|publisher=W. Taylor|page=123|url=https://archive.org/details/lifeandstranges04defogoog/page/n131/mode/1up?q=trial
|passage=Finding my first Seed did not grow, which I easily imagin’d was by the Drought, I sought for a moister Piece of Ground to make another '''Trial''' in,}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1839|author={{w|Charles Dickens}}|title={{w|Oliver Twist}}|location=London|publisher=Richard Bentley|volume=2|chapter=28|page=144|url=https://archive.org/details/olivertwist02dickrich/page/144/mode/1up?q=trial
|passage=He summoned up all his strength for one last '''trial''', and bent his faltering steps towards [the house].}}
#* {{RQ:Cather O Pioneers|chapter=1|page=18|passage=After a dozen '''trials''' he succeeded in lighting the lantern,}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1950|author={{w|Rachel Carson}}|title={{w|The Sea Around Us}}|location=New York|publisher=Oxford University Press|year_published=1961|chapter=1|page=7|url=https://www.fadedpage.com/books/20190551/html.php
|passage=Before the first living cell was created, there may have been many '''trials''' and failures.}}

====Verb====
{{en-verb|+l}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To carry out a series of [[test]]s on (a new product, procedure etc.) before marketing or implementing it.
#: {{ux|en|The warning system was extensively '''trialed''' before being fitted to all our vehicles.}}
#* {{RQ:en:New York Times|date=2022-09-27|author=Barclay Bram|title=My Therapist, the Robot|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2022/09/27/opinion/chatbot-therapy-mental-health.html|passage=In Britain, bots are being '''trialed''' to bridge waiting times for people seeking therapy but unable to get appointments and as an e-triage tool.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20221112044702/https://www.nytimes.com/2022/09/27/opinion/chatbot-therapy-mental-health.html}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To try out (a new player) in a sports team.
#: {{ux|en|The team '''trialled''' a new young goalkeeper in Saturday's match, with mixed results.}}

{{etymid|en|three}}

#: {{cot|en|singular|dual|plural}}
#: {{ux|en|No language has a '''trial''' number unless it has a dual.}}
